FFIRONSWORN.CoreTooOld: FastFighting Ironsworn needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFIRONSWORN.NeedsCore: FastFighting Ironsworn needs the FastFighting module. Enable it in Manage Modules.

rulesPreference.Name: Rules preference
rulesPreference.Hint: With more than one ruleset on in the world, Ironsworn, Starforged and Sundered Isles have moves of the same name that play differently (Strike, Clash, Endure Harm, Enter the Fray). A character makes its own sheet's moves, except where the preferred ruleset (if it's on) has a move of the same name: then it makes that one. Moves called differently (End the Fight, Take Decisive Action) stay its own.
rulesPreference.classic: Prefer Ironsworn moves when the names match
rulesPreference.starforged: Prefer Starforged moves when the names match
rulesPreference.sundered_isles: Prefer Sundered Isles moves when the names match

deadlyWeapons.Name: Characters fight with deadly weapons
deadlyWeapons.Hint: Ironsworn: a deadly weapon (a sword, an axe, a spear, a bow) inflicts 2 harm, an unarmed attack or a simple weapon 1. On, characters strike for 2 harm (3 on a strong Strike); off, 1. Only Ironsworn's Strike and Clash inflict harm this way; Starforged's mark progress.
